messages:
zach_billing: Quick heads up — BlueHarbor flagged a ~18% drop in streaming token usage on last week's invoice compared to their expected traffic. They think we undercounted streaming responses from EU region. Can we confirm?
maya_fin: Ugh. Do we have request IDs / sample timestamps? need the delta before we talk credits.
ryan_sre: I saw error spikes on eu-proxy-2 around 2026-03-15 03:00-06:00 UTC. Proxy was returning chunked responses without the final content-length header in some retry paths. Our meter relies on content-length for streaming partial accounting in that path.
lina_eng: Confirmed — a recent proxy change to temporarily disable body buffering introduced a path that bypasses the streaming-meter middleware. Repro steps: 1) enable `--no-buffer` on proxy 2) send large-stream request 3) observe stream chunks without final length.
anika_ml: For BlueHarbor specifically we can correlate their public request IDs — they gave a sample: req_3a8f7d2e. I pulled that id from the opentelemetry traces and it hit eu-proxy-2 at 2026-03-15T04:12:01Z.
sam_ops: I can run a log reindex to count tokens by request id. Proposed SQL from replay logs: 
```
SELECT request_id, sum(estimated_tokens) as tokens
FROM streaming_events
WHERE proxy = 'eu-proxy-2' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-16'
AND request_id IN ('req_3a8f7d2e', ... )
GROUP BY request_id;
```
Will do a fast run and post numbers.
replay-bot: started replay job replay-2067-eu-1 for window 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z (eta ~14m) :hourglass:
ryan_sre: Note: the undercount affects only streaming responses that used the no-buffer retry path. Non-streaming and other regions unaffected.
sam_ops: quick numbers from the reindex (first pass): estimated missing tokens = 2,134,890 tokens for BlueHarbor during the window. Will run a second pass with more request_id coverage.
lina_eng: Root fix is a 3-line change to ensure meter is wired into the no-buffer path. Will push a patch and we can backfill. Patch queued as ENG-9453.
anika_ml: Based on token delta and BlueHarbor's committed rate, estimated billable credit = $12,450 (rounded). Breakdown: 2,134,890 streaming tokens * $0.00584 per 1k tokens (their negotiated tier) => ~12,475; rounded to 12,450 to be conservative.
maya_fin: Need formal sign-off from finance director before issuing credit. Can we get an internal QA of the backfill method and a customer-facing note draft?
zelena_note: (small note) include TL;DR and reassurance about monitoring changes.
elena_finance: I can approve provisionally, pending: 1) dev QA doc with replay methodology, 2) confirmation that aggregated credit won't push them to a lower tier unexpectedly, 3) a short customer message draft. If all that is good, approve up to $15k. :white_check_mark:
zach_billing: I'll draft customer message and share - will include apology, explanation, and credit amount. Also tagging CS to prep for questions.
maya_fin: tagging cs-ledging for final customer communication review.
ryan_sre: FYI we added a monitoring alert to catch dropped streaming-meter events (mon: STREAM_METER_EU_MISS > 5 in 5m).
sam_ops: second pass complete: expanded ID set -> total missing tokens = 2,187,402. Revised estimate => $12,760.
anika_ml: Recommendation: issue credit for $12,760 and include a note that we fixed the ingestion path and added monitoring.
elena_finance: Approved. Please create a billing adjustment ticket and attach the replay logs + ENG-9453 link.
zach_billing: Will open BILL-1129 with supporting artifacts and send BlueHarbor the credit note. Draft below — please thumbs up if fine: 
"Hi BlueHarbor — we discovered a metering bug affecting streaming calls in EU region on Mar 15. We've applied a $12,760 credit to your account and deployed a fix; monitoring is in place. We apologize for the trouble and are happy to walk through the details if you'd like"
maya_fin: Looks good. :+1:
replay-bot: replay job replay-2067-eu-1 completed successfully (2,187,402 tokens reconstructed). Artifacts: s3://replay-exports/replay-2067-eu-1.json
lina_eng: PR merged to patch no-buffer path and a hotfix rolled to eu-proxy-2. Will follow up with post-deploy verification.
zach_billing: billing ticket BILL-1129 created and credit queued for next invoice cycle. Thanks team.
maya_fin: Great, close the loop and add postmortem summary to incidents channel once you have ENG-9453 final notes.
elena_finance: Thanks everyone. Keep the docs tight for audit trail.
